preflight_correction: Before any query scoring, numeric feature scale and target scale had a duplicate dictionary key. Renamed numeric_scale. Original source and error log preserved remotely; configuration, seeds, splits and gates unchanged.
hypothesis: Shared-weight ensemble regularization and fit-only piecewise numeric embeddings may reduce variance and learn numeric response interactions with sparse chemical fingerprints.
mechanism: Each dense weight matrix is shared by eight members with learned member input/output scalings initialized to independent random signs; residual MLP blocks, independent dropout and member biases; per-member MAE averaged in training and averaged member predictions at inference. Two fixed seeds.
fit_only_operations: Numeric columns selected by finite variation or varying missingness
novelty: No attention, molecule graph, conditional density decoder or pair-difference labels. Unlike earlier additive splines this is a nonlinear residual network over piecewise numeric inputs. Unlike earlier independent networks, every layer shares matrices across members with distinct trainable multiplicative factors.
acceptance: Unmodified v148: best minimum fold0/1 relative MAE reduction >0.012; freeze before fold2/valid; all four point gains positive; mean >0.012; both paired scaffold bootstrap 90% lower bounds >0; no fallback after rejection.
